title: DNA Extraction from Mouthwash Samples Using Qiagen DNeasy PowersoilPro Kit
author: Ahmed A Shibl
materials: Thaw the sample on ice for 00:30:00
Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet

steps.title: Transfer sample to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 1–2 mL of mouthwash sample into a 1.5 mL or 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) at 4 °C for 10 min to pellet material.

steps.title: Repeat if needed
steps.instruction: If the pellet is not visible or a higher DNA yield is required, repeat the centrifugation with additional volume.

steps.title: Add CD1 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of CD1, vortex to resuspend the pellet, then spin down briefly.

steps.title: Transfer to bead tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire tube contents into a PowerBead Pro tube.

steps.title: Bead beat sample
steps.instruction: Secure the PowerBead Pro tube onto the bead beater and run at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge bead tube
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PowerBead Pro tube at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min 30 s.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant without disturbing the pellet into a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add CD2
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of CD2 to the tube and vortex for 10 s.

steps.title: Centrifuge after CD2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min 30 s.

steps.title: Transfer second supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant carefully to a new clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Add CD3
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of CD3 and vortex for 10 s.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the lysate onto an MB spin column and centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min 30 s.

steps.title: Repeat lysate loading
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through and repeat the loading step until all lysate has been processed.

steps.title: EA wash
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a new collection tube, add 500 µL of EA, and centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min 30 s.

steps.title: Prepare for C5
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through and return the spin column to the collection tube.

steps.title: C5 wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of C5 onto the spin column and centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min 30 s.

steps.title: Final spin
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through, place the spin column back into the collection tube, centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 2 min, then transfer the column to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf (elution) tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50–100 µL of nuclease‑free water to the center of the spin column and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect eluate and store
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17,000 × g) for 1 min, quantify DNA using Qubit, flash‑freeze, and store at –20 °C or –80 °C.
